parent_prereg_note: S3-D thresholds / arms / seeds / episode budget are inherited UNCHANGED and remain the single source of truth for the verdict; this doc only adds a training-side robustification mechanism.
motivation: S3-D substantively proved learnability of when-to-steer from sparse outcome credit (4/5 seeds robustly passed), but 1/5 seed (seed 1) collapsed to always-steer under an unlucky init, tripping the worst-seed CI-lower gate to a literal FAIL. Program decision (user option A): accept substantive learnability and add a standard REINFORCE robustification (multi-restart with honest model selection), then rerun once under the identical decision rules.

robustification.mechanism: multi-restart per seed with train-side model selection
robustification.restart_seed_rule: restart_seed = seed * 1000 + restart_index (distinct init + action + episode RNG per restart)
robustification.selection_metric: mean argmax-gate chosen-NLL over TRAIN rows (lower is better)
robustification.selection_never_uses: heldout rows, heldout arm NLLs, gate/CI/selectivity verdict metrics
robustification.why_honest: Selection reads only training rows -- identical to standard validation-based model selection. The collapsed always-steer policy has strictly worse TRAIN NLL (dragged down by the post-switch 7.0 penalty), so best-train selection provably rejects the collapsed restart without peeking at any verdict metric.
robustification.evaluated_policy: the single selected restart is evaluated on heldout for every reported arm / CI / selectivity

unchanged_from_parent.decision_rules: identical (convergence>=0.2, gain_vs_noop>=0.3 & CI>0, gain_vs_always_on>=0.2 & CI>0, gain_vs_random>=0.2 & CI>0, gate_selectivity>=0.3, structural integrity)
unchanged_from_parent.policy_optimizer: minibatch REINFORCE (policy_batch_cases=8) + running baseline + advantage normalization + entropy regularization
unchanged_from_parent.frozen_components: sensor reader / executor / substrate all frozen; only gate policy params updated online

prohibited_after_execution: change policy_restarts, selection metric, thresholds, arms, seeds or episode budget after seeing results
select restarts by any heldout / verdict metric
train or fine-tune reader / executor / substrate
feed active_subgoal ground truth into policy loss or gate observation
rewrite sealed verdicts: kill-eta / S2 / B screen / C2 / S3-prereq / S3-D

on_result.all_pass_including_worst_seed: learnability + worst-seed robustness both substantiated under identical rules; admit independent authoritative sweep (still SHADOW, no production promotion)
on_result.still_worst_seed_fail: report honestly that standard restart robustification is insufficient on the surrogate; do not weaken thresholds
